scenarios.name: Retain a staged property column while switching table categories

scenario_steps.name: an empty part with multiple model states is active in the MCAD Software
the model-state table contains the Category property column
the user selects Comments and adds it to the chosen properties
the chosen properties include Category and Comments
the member grid contains Category and Comments columns
the user selects the Suppression category
the member grid still contains Category and Comments columns
the user returns to the Properties category
the chosen properties include Category and Comments
the user cancels the table dialog
